footnote_text: These shares vest on October 1, 2027 pursuant to a restricted stock unit award granted under the QumulusAI, Inc. 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. || Includes 27,847 shares to be issued upon vesting and settlement pursuant to restricted stock unit awards granted under the QumulusAI, Inc. 2026 Equity Incentive Plan, conditioned upon the Reporting Person remaining a director of QumulusAI through the applicable vesting dates.

Grant of restricted stock units (RSUs), each of which represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock of QMCO. The RSUs vest in full on the earlier of October 1, 2027 or the date of the Companys next annual meeting of stockholders, in each case subject to the Reporting Persons continued service on the Companys Board of Directors.
